name: ColoringBookify
original_description: Turn an idea into a printable coloring book in conversation. Plan scenes, choose a visual style, and confirm the plan before generation. Open the finished book as a PDF and view individual page images. Refine the artwork with edit previews, compare the original and proposed versions, and accept or discard each change. Browse existing books and characters from your connected ColoringBookify account. Intended for creators, parents, and educators.

limitations_ja: 接続したアカウントを使用。印刷注文やマーケットへの出版はスキル欄で対象外と説明。
